name: Peach 2:1 CBD + Hybrid Enhanced Gummies
description:
New to edibles? Our Peach 2:1 CBD:THC gummies are made with more CBD than THC, making them a great option for easing into edibles. They are made with real fruit and enhanced with a balanced Hybrid terpene profile that may assist in creating a sense of ease and overall well being. It’s a little like a vacation for your body. Enjoy!

100mg CBD:50mg THC per package, 10mg CBD:5mg THC per gummy.
